title: The Universe Behind Every No
evidence_boundary: This script explores the metaphysical ideas of probable selves, symbolic good and evil, and belief-shaped experience presented in Seth Speaks. These ideas are philosophical and spiritual interpretations, not established scientific findings.
desired_movement: From seeing choice as the destruction of alternatives to seeing it as moral participation in the kind of reality one continually strengthens.
grounding: The closing returns the metaphysics of probable worlds to the viewer's next ordinary decision and its effect on the life directly in front of them.
invitation: Notice what kind of world your next choice rehearses into existence.
end_card_question: What kind of universe is your next choice rehearsing?
voice_standard: Liam - magnetic and intimate, like a brilliant friend revealing a forbidden map after midnight. Playful wonder through the probable-world turns, grounded and morally serious through harm and responsibility, then spacious and near-whispered at the close.
